text: Alliance with Westshire reached in ~20 s real time and 0 game ticks: three Tribute clicks (75 of 199 starting coins) took relations 0->+30 while the Nations screen pauses the world (tick stayed 1387), then Ally accepted. No cooldown or diminishing returns on gifts.

Denounce on an ally silently ends the alliance (Allied +30 -> Neutral +5) in one click with no confirmation and no hint on the button that it breaks the alliance. Also my first Denounce click did not register (slow frames), second did.
War confirmation: the button relabels to 'Confirm' but the status line says 'Click War again to declare war on Westshire.' - there is no War button on screen any more.

War declared only after several tries: the War confirm window expires ('Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.') after a few seconds of real time; at 2-5 fps with hover-before-click, a normal second click often lands after it expired and just re-arms it. Took 5 attempts (~2.5 min) before two rapid clicks worked.

Peace accepted at the same tick war was declared (tick 1387; the Nations screen pauses the world) with the reason 'the fighting has cost them enough' although no fighting happened. Relations jump Hostile -60 -> Neutral -19. Declare war then sue for peace is free and instant.

Right after peace the row reads 'Neutral (-19), truce 60 s' yet War is still offered; declaring war during the truce succeeds with no warning and no extra penalty (relations back to -60), so the truce does not bind the player.

Chronicle panel truncates entries with '...' ('Fortressham and Westshire made peace, ending...', 'Relations between Fortressham and Westshire...'); the panel has room on screen but the key part of the line is cut.
